title: ManageEngine OpManager OpmSkipFilter Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of ManageEngine OpManager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the OpmSkipFilter class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose files in the context of the service account.
